name: Frustum-Occlusion Culling for Octree Traversal
aliases: Voxel LOD selection via Frustum Culling
Voxel Rasterization via Frustum Culling and Instancing
summary: Frustum-Occlusion Culling for Octree Traversal identifies visible voxels by culling nodes outside the view frustum or smaller than one pixel, outputting a list of 3D bounding boxes for hardware instancing instead of ray-marching.
